description: 11th-century collection of short maxims arranged according to behavioral categories, originally composed in Arabic. Complete Musar text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Musar is Jewish ethical and devotional literature concerned with character, discipline and the conduct of ordinary life. Its genre ranges from short letters to systematic treatises.
